help.title: Help & Support
help.intro: Need a hand? Browse common questions or reach the support team.

faq.q1: How do I fund my wallet?
faq.a1: Go to Wallet → Fund Wallet. You can fund via bank transfer to your virtual account.
faq.a2: Delivery times vary by distance and rider availability. Most deliveries within Katsina complete in 30–60 minutes.
faq.q3: How do I track my order?
faq.a3: Once a rider is assigned, you'll see real-time tracking on the order details screen.
faq.a4: You can cancel before a rider picks up your package. Cancellation after pickup may incur a fee.
faq.q5: What if my delivery is damaged?
faq.a5: Contact support within 24 hours with photos. We'll investigate and process a refund if applicable.
